note: Structural assertions, graded by an independent reader against the run's visible output and the files it wrote. Baseline arm is the same prompt with the skill unavailable.

cases.prompt: /better-goal divide the remaining work into md files in docs/features-to-triage then use /ship-fleet:ship-fleet until all items are complete
assert: Enumerates the actual remaining items from the repo (ORCHESTRATOR.md, features-to-triage, specs, LEDGER) rather than restating 'all items'
Writes docs/goals/goal-<slug>.md containing a worklist table with IDs and a gates table with runnable commands
Proposes a condition and states its character count, which is <= 4000
The condition names at least one command whose exit code settles it
The condition carries a turn or time bound
The condition carries a blocked-item policy that does not involve stopping to ask
Runs preflight and reports the block-cap row
Shows a settings diff before writing anything

cases.prompt: /goal /better-goal continue using ship-fleet to resolve all issues, gaps and remaining work
assert: Identifies that the live goal condition is the literal slash-command text and that no evaluator can verify it
States this in roughly one line rather than a section
Replaces it with a grounded condition instead of layering a second goal on top

cases.prompt: The goal is set but you stopped again. Why?
assert: Names the 8-consecutive-block override as the mechanism, and that the turn is reported as 'completed'
Names the impossible verdict as the other silent-clear path
Checks the ledger or goal-state.json rather than inferring from the transcript
Proposes CLAUDE_CODE_STOP_HOOK_BLOCK_CAP plus a bounded max_iterations, not one or the other

cases.prompt: /better-goal keep improving the deck pipeline until the generated slides look as good as the reference html
assert: States plainly that 'look as good as' is not settleable by a command
Does not silently accept it — either derives a measurable proxy or names the limitation explicitly
Still produces a bounded, armed run rather than refusing

cases.prompt: /better-goal run /code-review every turn until it reports no findings
assert: Flags that /code-review is disable-model-invocation and reaches a scheduled fire as plain text
Proposes calling it from the main turn or naming the underlying command

cases.prompt: /better-goal ship the backlog (in a repo where the workspace is untrusted or disableAllHooks is set)
assert: Preflight blocks and names the specific setting
Does not arm
Says what would clear it

process_evals: The brief is written to docs/goals/, not pasted into the chat
The character count of the condition is stated, not estimated
The final report names: condition, gates, bounds, ledger path, status command, disarm command
No subagent is spawned to check the condition or review the brief
The skill does not begin doing the underlying work in the arming pass
